sections.title: Salam in Perspective
sections.extract: Salam in Perspective Abdus Salam was a rare phenomenon: a great scientist, a humanitarian and a strong promoter of his message that science is the common heritage of all mankind. He will surely be remembered for his many seminal contributions to physics, some of which have proven to be of lasting value. These include his pioneering work on electroweak uniﬁcation for which he shared the Nobel Prize in physics in 1979
